author: Christopher 'Suggsey' Smith
text:
Close the app down for 30 seconds and restart the app. I’ve found with IOS 18.3 and 2+ sensor over original 2 sensor stability of connection is better, by no means as good or stable or within the claimed range by Abbott and even looses signal through a Pertex and Pile jacket between a distance of under a metre and will only re scan if it put the phone inside the arm of said jacket, will not scan through the fabrics!
That is my only real disappointment overall with the system. None of my other connectables suffer from drop in communications.
